verdicts.reason: Both lose the hero photo of praying hands entirely, so the design is no longer recognisable. A leaves a meaningless black sliver cropped at the top and ghostly white cross and cloud fragments floating on the left, but the quote and its attribution keep a sensible gap between them. B has the same top sliver plus a second cropped black strip at the bottom with the crosses rammed into it, a faint cloud shape stranded on the left, and 'MAHATMA GANDHI' jammed right under the quote, which makes it more fragmented and more cramped than A.
